R01.quote: `enum status: {...}, _prefix: true` raises `ArgumentError` ... Fix: `enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true`. Works on 7.0.
R01.reasons: Validation: the plan gives only overall suite results, with no persisted draft/ready filter or helper check after reload.

R02.quote: Fix: `serialize :tags, coder: JSON`. Does not work on 7.0, so it ships with the upgrade. ... raw `["a","b"]` round-trips identically
R02.reasons: Validation: the probe only round-trips raw data; it does not test editing comma-separated input or unequal tags after reload.

R03.reasons: Validation: there is no specific edit/reload/form-rendering check, only the general suite result.

R04.quote: `PG::UndefinedColumn: column notes.notebooks does not exist`. The notebook filter and pagination break. Fix: `where(notebook: @notebook)`.
R04.reasons: Validation: there are no unequal notebook populations and no foreign-owner denial checks.

R05.quote: the receipt CSV's doi column comes out empty on 8.1. It was `10.1000/Essays.1` on 7.0. Fix: `citation&.doi`.
R05.reasons: Validation: the plan reports one observation, not a check comparing distinct DOIs against persisted citations.

R06.quote: a failing row now commits the import and the earlier rows ... Since 7.2 a non-local return always commits, regardless of `load_defaults`. Fix: `raise ActiveRecord::Rollback ...`
R06.reasons: Validation: the plan names the test and its counts, but has no successful-batch control or fresh PostgreSQL count check through a real request.

R07.quote: `TypeError: String can't be coerced into Integer`. Every export job fails. Fix: `fragments.join`.
R07.reasons: Validation: there is no real-worker check of the exact ordered Markdown bytes or of the failed-export control.

R08.quote: `HashWithIndifferentAccess#stringify_keys` now stringifies integer keys ... annotations vanish from the import preview. Fix: use `@import.annotations` directly.
R08.reasons: Validation: there is no check with unequal annotations at lines 2 and 4 that includes a multiline row.

R10.quote: across a DST change the preview shows `2026-11-01T08:00:00-05:00` instead of `09:00:00-04:00`. The instant is the same (+86400 s)
R10.reasons: Validation: the DST boundary case is covered, but there is no non-boundary control or explicit epoch/offset comparison.

R11.quote: the digest subject changed from "October 05" to "October 04" ... Fix: `requested_at = params[:requested_at].utc` in the mailer.
R11.reasons: Validation: there is no real queue/worker check that crosses each midnight or inspects reservation keys and note membership.

R13.quote: `NoMethodError: undefined method 'utc' for an instance of Integer`. Scheduling and postponing reminders return 500. Fix: `wait_until: Time.at(reminder_epoch)`.
R13.reasons: Validation: there is no inspection of the scheduled payload/score or the persisted schedule time.

R14.quote: only when a retry happens: `RuntimeError: Couldn't determine a delay based on :exponentially_longer`. Fix: `:polynomially_longer`, which does not exist on 7.0, or a lambda
R14.reasons: Impact: names the error but not that bounded retries fall through to Sidekiq retries. Validation: there is no persistent-503 request count or 503->200/401 controls.

R15.quote: `Passed nil to the :model argument, expect an object or false`. The notes list returns 500. Fix: drop `model: nil`.
R15.reasons: Validation: the only check is a grep; there is no render/submit check of field names, method and resulting membership.

R16.quote: split it into `get "/notes", to: "notes#index", as: :notes` and `get "/journal", to: "notes#index"`
R16.reasons: Validation: there is no explicit check that requests both URLs as an owner.

R17.quote: `show_exceptions = false` no longer raises in tests; tests got a 404 instead of `RecordNotFound`. Fix: set it to `:none`. That value is only valid from 7.1
R17.reasons: Validation: there is no explicit raised-exception/missing-record check and no CI eager-load mode check.

R18.quote: start from `allowed_tags || sanitizer.class.allowed_tags + [attachment tag, "figure", "figcaption"]` and add `details summary`
R18.reasons: Validation: the existing test covers excerpts and unsafe markup only generally; it does not cover attachments, handlers or javascript URLs.

R19.quote: set `config.x.citation_provider = config_for(:citation_provider)...` ... the credentials test asserts the exact Basic auth header.
R19.reasons: Validation: there is no fresh-process check with special-character credentials and no bounded-failure check.

R09.quote: `raise_on_invalid_cache_expiration_time`: the export partial raises ... for expired exports. Clamp `expires_in` or skip the cache when the export is not downloadable.
R09.reasons: Recommendation: the skip-cache option is offered on equal footing with clamping and is known to break the stale-link contract. Validation: no deadline or cache-hit tests are specified.

R20.quote: `Notebook` `serialize :preferences` fails at load with `missing keyword: :coder`. Add `coder: YAML` (7.1+ only); stored YAML stays readable.
R20.reasons: Validation: per-level suite logs exist, but there is no create/edit/reload of unequal preferences with the gate both off and on.

R21.quote: `NotebooksController#update` raises `ActiveRecord::ReadonlyAttributeError: slug`, because `notebook_params` permits `:slug`. Remove `:slug` from the permitted params.
R21.reasons: Recommendation: removing slug from the shared params does not ensure creation still sets the slug. Validation: there is no creation or persisted-slug check.

R23.quote: `postgresql_adapter_decode_dates`: `Notebook#daily_note_counts` raises `TypeError` ... Fix with `Date.iso8601(day.to_s)` or handle a Date, which works on both.
R23.reasons: Validation: there is no explicit decoding off/on test with asymmetric counts, empty reports and ownership.

R25.quote: `strict_freshness`: the export download checks only `If-None-Match` when both headers are sent; the existing test passes.
R25.reasons: Impact: the 200-to-304 change is not stated. Recommendation: no explicit keep/adopt decision is made. Validation: only the existing test is cited.

R12.quote: When I gave those payloads to 7.0, it raised `... BigDecimalSerializer is not known` ... Jobs queued by 7.0 run correctly on 8.1 ... pass `completion` as a String
R12.reasons: Validation: both cross-version directions were tested, but there are no same-version controls and no check of the exact delivered completion percentage.
